attack_matrix.attack: Signed int.MinValue and equal-hash unequal stable keys
attack_matrix.assessment: Original comparer hash is retained as signed int; no absolute-value overflow or key normalization. Dictionary<int,Bucket> routes equal hashes; user equality resolves collision within linked slots. Prepare rejects only actual equal keys.
attack_matrix.credit: STATIC_SUPPORTED; current collision-equality pair uses constant int.MinValue, native corrected run pending.

attack_matrix.attack: Later secondary hash/equality preparation throws after a primary slot is prepared
attack_matrix.assessment: Every index slot, entry slot-dictionary capacity and owner entry capacity are prepared before any live index publication. A later callback failure leaves no linked slot in earlier live index; direct caller retains value, failed factory disposes uncommitted value.
attack_matrix.credit: STATIC_SUPPORTED; existing new admission pairs provide finite original source-specific failures, corrected native pending.

attack_matrix.attack: Publication invokes user comparison or allocation after irreversible first publication
attack_matrix.owners: PreparedResourceMap.Publish; CommitValue_NoLock; pending reservation; AddIndex final metadata loop
attack_matrix.assessment: Publication uses only prepared slot links and int/reference/string-ordinal owner dictionaries with preallocated capacity. Current ordinary callbacks complete first. Under frozen integration and excluded fatal/OOM/reentrant/mutable-key contract, no remaining fallible user hash/equality/selector callback occurs during publication.
attack_matrix.credit: STATIC_SUPPORTED, not universal no-throw under arbitrary internal misuse.

attack_matrix.attack: Bulk AddIndex fails after processing first existing entry
attack_matrix.assessment: The new index is still private during every comparer call. No existing entry.Slots references it until all private preparation and all metadata capacity preparation complete. Duplicate-key/preparation/version failure therefore cannot attach unpublished index metadata. ResetEntries clears abandoned prior projection slots before a retry.
attack_matrix.credit: STATIC_SUPPORTED; dedicated hostile comparator AFTER first projected entry lacks current13 causal coverage; Root additional paired fixture pending.

attack_matrix.attack: Required clock/lookup fails after an earlier expired resource has already been retired
attack_matrix.assessment: Operation-owned removed list exists before changes and is released in finally. Required public timestamp/elapsed errors remain caller errors; timed cleanup records/logs ordinary required-clock failure while tracked cleanup task and flag complete. Callback/disposal logging remains isolated.
attack_matrix.credit: STATIC_SUPPORTED; current lookup-after-expiration pair covers one public comparer failure; third TimestampFrequency read after first expired retirement and per-owner/periodic tests are pending mandatory acceptance proof.

attack_matrix.attack: Hostile secondary comparer during committed retirement
attack_matrix.assessment: Exact linked slot is removed by identity without calling user hash/equality. Parent entry bookkeeping, key/value references and slot dictionary are cleared.
attack_matrix.credit: STATIC_SUPPORTED; current hostile Remove pair targets this, corrected native pending.

attack_matrix.attack: Old invalidated factory cleanup deletes a new same-key pending replacement
attack_matrix.assessment: Each pending owner stores its exact slot. First removal nulls pending.Slot; later cleanup is idempotent. Replacement has another linked slot and cannot be located/removed by old key cleanup. Empty old bucket removal is harmless because old linked flag prevents second removal.
attack_matrix.credit: STATIC_SUPPORTED; LateOldFactory public gate case targets pending map after old cleanup, not only previously captured waiter tasks.

attack_matrix.attack: Persistent originating comparer fails while pending factory completes
attack_matrix.assessment: Initial reservation failure disposes only created linked CTS before any creation operation count is incremented. After successful reservation, final cleanup removes by slot without further comparer calls, completes request/release TCS and disposes CTS. Rejected factory value is disposed once before terminal fault completion.
attack_matrix.credit: STATIC_SUPPORTED; owned original child can establish finite irreversible corruption only, no original task/cache join credit.

attack_matrix.attack: Historical rejected keys/dead slots accumulate or retain resource/key graphs
attack_matrix.assessment: Rejected new-hash preparation does not insert a bucket. Last removal drops live bucket; every retired slot clears neighbors/key/value, entry slot references clear and pending slot nulls. Dictionary backing capacity can retain a historical peak but peak is bounded by configured live capacity plus preparation, not failed-attempt key history. Caller-owned attempts/index count/GC/RSS are not device RAM guarantees.
attack_matrix.credit: STATIC_SUPPORTED; no runtime heap/RSS or arbitrary-index-count claim.

attack_matrix.attack: Middle/head/tail removal under collisions preserves remaining lookup identities
attack_matrix.assessment: Both neighboring links plus first/last are updated, removed links clear, and only an empty bucket is dropped. Current collision pair reaches head/tail disposal; a public three-distinct-key equal-hash middle-removal/reinsert case would strengthen branch evidence.

attack_matrix.attack: Treat generic prepared map as a multiple-outstanding-slot transaction
attack_matrix.owners: PreparedResourceMap.Prepare/Publish and all actual call sites
attack_matrix.assessment: Two unpublished same-hash new-bucket slots would reference different buckets; second publication is rejected. Two same-key unlinked preparations can pass duplicate checks before either links. Current integration avoids both: each live map has one prepared slot before publication under cache monitor; private bulk AddIndex prepares and publishes one row at a time. Do not generalize this helper to batching without revisiting preparation reservation semantics.
attack_matrix.credit: INTERNAL_CALLER_PRECONDITION, not an actual frozen-callsite defect.

test_and_acceptance_limits.target: ResourceCache.AddIndex failure during comparator preparation of later existing row
test_and_acceptance_limits.why_current_tests_do_not_prove: Existing DuplicateProjection rejects in early duplicate preparation and merely checks GetIndex/count; successful projection and current13 direct/factory admission do not exercise failed bulk late comparer metadata.
test_and_acceptance_limits.recommended_public_oracle: Two committed values; chosen stable comparator throws on later row preparation; prove chosen exception, absent named new index, both primary values/count/caller ownership, no subsequent unpublished-index callback on retirement, retry same index name healthy and exact disposal counts. Preserve original-native finite failure and corrected/native one-cause proof separately.
test_and_acceptance_limits.status: Root is authoring/reviewing private paired R7; no code/native credit here.

test_and_acceptance_limits.target: Get/GetOrAdd/Remove/Add/CleanupExpired/periodic cleanup after first retirement in CollectExpired
test_and_acceptance_limits.why_current_tests_do_not_prove: Current lookup comparer-after-expiration tests one later failure; existing clock-lockorder test invokes a nonthrowing timestamp callback. Neither proves partial multi-entry expiry release on later required elapsed-clock error or tracked periodic recovery.
test_and_acceptance_limits.recommended_public_oracle: Two expired owned resources, required TimestampFrequency fails third read after first entry has passed MinAge/MaxAge and retired. Before primary-reference assertion, prove exactly one actual disposal/removal/eviction, remaining second undisposed and indexed/snapshot intact. Public callers preserve chosen source exception, incoming direct candidate stays caller-owned and factory never runs when fault precedes creation; healthy pairs and cache-owner joins. Controlled TimeProvider actual timer callback path must finish tracked cleanup and allow a later healthy pass.
test_and_acceptance_limits.status: Root acknowledges and is authoring separate public/clock/timer fixtures; native pending.

test_and_acceptance_limits.recommended_public_oracle: Public secondary index with three distinct equal-hash keys, remove middle, both survivor references retained; then reinsert key and remove remaining ends. Existing int.MinValue equality pair covers one hash extreme but not all unlink positions.
test_and_acceptance_limits.status: No runtime proof credited; static links inspected.
